svg.title: A two-step gesture request
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio. 2560 x 1440 SVG with an embedded 3840 x 2160 background and editable Inter text.

text.tspan: Gestures confirm the ride request. A separate card tap starts boarding once the taxi has stopped.
The window starts after palm detection.
Complete the thumb hold within it.
The web demo shows the arriving vehicle
Reset on timeout or sustained loss.
Track hands independently; hands are not people.
Prevent duplicate triggers from other tracks.
Web source c364de64: 2 / 8 / 2 s configuration. Unity uses independent XR pose holds of 2 s and 3 s; there is no live web-to-Unity bridge.
